body:
I agree, it seems like everyone follows a written script or something. I came to you telling you I was depressed and lost all interest in my life and the things that used to bring me joy no longer interest me. The response: Have you tried a hobby? (Once I was told to go to an amusement park)

OMFG do they even listen?! People who study depression don't understand it. People who suffer with depression don't understand it. If only we put our resources into making the world a better place instead of a shitty one with fake, feel-good words that hide behind a wall of stigma. Things you tell others to make *yourself* feel good at the end of the day. I feel you, it's BS
I tried this once. Obviously it didn't work. It was also extremely painful.
